image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a disorganized pile of toilet paper rolls. There are at least three visible rolls: one in the foreground left with a decorative black and gold patterned cardboard core, one in the background right showing a standard brown cardboard core, and a large, partially unrolled section of white tissue draping over the top. A green package or box is partially visible at the bottom center. The lighting is soft and diffuse, casting gentle shadows within the pile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows multiple cylindrical rolls composed of wound white paper. The structure is consistent with standard toilet tissue rolls.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions of the rolls relative to each other and the visible packaging suggest standard consumer dimensions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While perforations are a standard feature, the resolution and angle of the image do not allow for the clear visual confirmation of individual perforation holes on the surface of the rolled paper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface of the paper exhibits a subtle texture and shadowing consistent with embossed or quilted ply, rather than being perfectly smooth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The hollow centers of the rolls are clearly visible, revealing cardboard tubes (one plain brown, one decorated).
The paper material is consistently white/off-white across all visible rolls.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The light reflection on the paper is matte, and the edge details show the expected softness and fibrous nature of tissue paper.
Similar to the geometry checkpoint, specific separation lines between sheets are not resolvable at this zoom level.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is unmistakably identified as household toilet tissue in its standard roll form.

alignment_reasoning: The image perfectly matches the target class 'toilet tissue'. All testable checkpoints regarding geometry (cylindrical rolls), functional components (cardboard cores, white color, texture), and material context (matte fibrous look) are present. Non-testable checkpoints (perforations) were correctly excluded. The presence of multiple rolls and a partial unrolling adds realism without deviating from the class definition.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts were detected. The textures are consistent, edges are sharp where appropriate and soft where expected (paper fibers), and there is no evidence of melting, fusion, or structural collapse. The lighting and shadows are physically plausible.
